Finding 1: Top SQL Statements
Impact is 1.06 active sessions, 26.84% of total activity.
---------------------------------------------------------
SQL statements consuming significant database time were found. These
statements offer a good opportunity for performance improvement.

   Recommendation 1: SQL Tuning
   Estimated benefit is .44 active sessions, 11.1% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate the PL/SQL statement with SQL_ID "8as8s1k2fhhqb" for
      possible performance improvements. You can supplement the information
      given here with an ASH report for this SQL_ID.
      Related Object
         SQL statement with SQL_ID 8as8s1k2fhhqb.
         BEGIN PKG_CBVER02_FRDRTGSFL.READ_FILES(:1,:2,:3,:4,:5); END;
   Rationale
      The SQL Tuning Advisor cannot operate on PL/SQL statements.
   Rationale
      Database time for this SQL was divided as follows: 0% for SQL execution,
      0% for parsing, 0% for PL/SQL execution and 100% for Java execution.
   Rationale
      SQL statement with SQL_ID "8as8s1k2fhhqb" was executed 9 times and had
      an average elapsed time of 49 seconds.
   Rationale
      Waiting for event "OJVM: Generic" in wait class "Other" accounted for
      94% of the database time spent in processing the SQL statement with
      SQL_ID "8as8s1k2fhhqb".

Finding 2: Session Connect and Disconnect
Impact is .84 active sessions, 21.17% of total activity.
--------------------------------------------------------
Session connect and disconnect calls were consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .84 active sessions, 21.17% of total activity.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate application logic for possible reduction of connect and
      disconnect calls. For example, you might use a connection pool scheme in
      the middle tier.

Impact is .4 active sessions, 10.19% of total activity.

JAVA execution consumed significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .4 active sessions, 10.19% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action

      significant time in Java execution. For example, the PL/SQL statement
      with SQL_ID "8as8s1k2fhhqb" is responsible for 100% of Java execution
      time during the analysis period.


Finding 4: Unusual "Other" Wait Event
Impact is .4 active sessions, 10% of total activity.

database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .4 active sessions, 10% of total activity.

      "Database Reference" for the description of this wait event.
   Action
      Look at the "Top SQL Statements" finding for SQL statements consuming
      significant time on the "OJVM: Generic" wait event. For example, the

Finding 5: Soft Parse
Impact is .32 active sessions, 8.09% of total activity.
-------------------------------------------------------
Soft parsing of SQL statements was consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .32 active sessions, 8.09% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
